meeting.type: Special Session — Budget Assumptions Work Session
meeting.summary: Capital Projects review for FY2023. Council discussed reallocating Well 1 funds to a new well, petroglyph fencing, a potential new library/community center near Cory Wride Memorial Park, library-certification grant funding, paving the Community Development yard, City Hall land acquisition, a City Facilities Master Plan, City Center streetscape landscaping, the Wasatch Wing and Clay interlocal cost share, and water/sewer impact-fee project status.
